products.title: CuraStep Relief Flip-Flops
products.body_html: CuraStep Relief brings acupressure-inspired design into an everyday flip-flop. Dr Cura Relief features a textured footbed designed to create targeted contact across the sole as you walk, paired with comfortable cushioning and a grippy outsole for everyday use. An easy-wearing design built to make every step feel more stimulating and comfortable.

products.title: CuraStep Align Flip-flop
products.body_html: CuraStep Align is designed around a supportive toe structure that helps your foot sit more naturally and securely through everyday movement. Dr Cura Align combines targeted toe support with a comfortable footbed and grippy outsole, giving your feet a more stable feel with every step. Built for effortless everyday wear, from quick errands to long hours on your feet.

products.title: CuraStep Cloud Flip-flop
products.body_html: CuraStep Cloud is engineered for everyday comfort with a 3-layer foam construction designed to create a softer, more cushioned feel underfoot. Dr Cura Cloud combines layered cushioning with a supportive footbed and grippy outsole to make long hours on your feet feel easier. Lightweight and easy to wear, it is built for everything from daily errands to relaxed all-day use.

products.title: Men's BioArmour
products.body_html: Bio Armour is engineered around the biomechanics of the human foot, where every structural element is designed to work with your natural movement. Its anatomical support cage, adaptive dial-fit system and responsive cushioning function together to maximize stability, energy transfer and comfort across every stride. Designed as a true hybrid platform, it performs seamlessly through running, cycling and strength training.

products.title: Men's Blackbird
products.body_html: The Blackbird is built on aerospace-driven design principles, where every detail is engineered for efficiency, control, and performance. Its responsive cushioning system and propulsion plate work together to maximize energy return, while structural elements ensure stability across every movement. Designed for versatility, it performs seamlessly across all conditions.
